sentences.en: She plays with her hair compulsively when she studies.
sentences.zh: 当她学习时，禁不住地摆弄头发。

sentences.en: Tom compulsively writes sentences every day.
sentences.zh: 汤姆每天禁不住地写句子。

sentences.en: She compels herself to check her phone compulsively throughout the day.
sentences.zh: 她一整天都禁不住地频繁查看手机。
